rules_inventory.name: require-json-parse-try-catch
rules_inventory.summary: Flags JSON.parse(...) calls not lexically inside a try block.
known_gaps: Only matches direct JSON.parse member calls; misses computed access JSON['parse'](), destructured { parse } = JSON, and aliased const p = JSON.parse.
isInsideTryBlock uses lexical ancestry; unsound for deferred callbacks (.then/.catch/addEventListener/.on/setTimeout/setInterval/queueMicrotask/Promise executor) defined in a try but invoked later.
Generic diagnostic, no hasSuggestions/suggest fix, does not reference canonical safe-parse helpers already in the repo (parseJsonWithRepair, parseJsonlContent).

refinement_priorities: P1 false-negative: indirect/computed JSON.parse access invisible to rule
P2 false-negative: lexical try-ancestry unsound for deferred callbacks
P3 diagnostic-quality: add ESLint suggestion + reference canonical helpers
